Flow.description: Determines and retrieves/outputs Product Line/Business Function most at risk, Trigger, and 5 respective reason codes. If business function or trigger cannot be determined user is prompted to enter Business Function and Trigger. If Business Function and Trigger are already known the respective reason codes stored on the record will be output. Reason code is set to 'N/A' if blank value returned on record.
